profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a practiced at working on deadlines in an organized fashion that allows transparency. I learned to work effectively under pressure as I graduated early throughout schooling. These strengths combined with a desire for excellence have allowed me to succeed up to this point.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer

• Developed real-time energy curtailment solutions to meet the needs of large utility companies
• Improved software performance by identifying and addressing performance bottlenecks, deadlock issues, and database inefficiencies
• Integrate against 3rd party thermostats by developing libraries in Elixir and exposing them as RESTful APIs with phoenix
• Produce and maintain internal tools to improve business workflow including Docker deployments, and shell scripts

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
At Comverge my position wears three predominant hats.  
•	Service Desk
       ◦	I support our software platform internally by educating various internal customers on how the software is suppose to work, and help diagnose errors from human error to bugs in our software.
       ◦	I work side by side our developers to develop use cases for various functionality, and how to make the platform as efficient as possible.
       ◦	I also work with our external customers to diagnose and correct our software on servers when it needed. 
•	Database Administration
       ◦	Mysql Views
               ▪	We have 34 views that I maintain and have help design.
               ▪	Some of our views are as simple as 2 or 3 joins while others have as many as 48 mysql joins. 
               ▪	We have several utilities that request specialized reports that are built from the same 34 views so one of the pleasures of my position is to ensure that a simple change for a client will not affect others. I work closely with our SSRS team to ensure  they have the data they need to make their specialized reports.
       ◦	One off data inquires
               ▪	I work several internal customers that request one of reports that require reverse engineering to ensure they can provide various functionality. 
               ▪	I work closely with our Operations team to assist in data integrity checks, and data reconciliation when needed.
•	Development
       ◦	Since there is over lap between service desk and development I find myself in a position to assist our development team in the various use cases, as well as current functionality of our software. 
       ◦	I develop in Ruby on Rails to create both future functionality as well as to correct bugs in our system.

positions.title: Student Mentor
positions.description: After completing the curriculum at Davinci I was invited to return to help guide others in their pursuit of development. I find myself being as accessible as possible to the students I have been assigned to field questions about the industry or the homework assigned.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- The class covers learning the ruby programming language, the rails framework and creating apps
- Review homework and make refactoring suggestions
- Help students with problem solving to clear errors in code
- Assist instructor with administrative tasks

positions.title: Program Management Executive
positions.description:
Provides analytic support in executing internal control discipline and operational excellence
with a Line of Business.
• Prepare documentation for the tracking, monitoring, and escalation of risk related issues to
management.
• Assists team in gathering and organizing data that will help track, report and manage internal
control gap issues and mitigation plan.

positions.title: Loan Modification Underwriter
positions.description:
• Analyze mortgage file, evaluate borrower's financials, manually calculating rate of pay, review
bank statements, tax returns and perform loan decisions by Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, DOJ
Investor and Industry guidelines keeping in compliance with all company policy and procedures.
• Knowledgeable of principle practices and regulations applicable to mortgage lending.
• Track all required documentation to assure processing timeframes are being met and update
system with statuses.

positions.title: Student Administrative Pastor
positions.description: Organizing events, logistics, attendance, creating marketing plans and executing,  public speaking, and managing a team of leaders.

projects.title: Schedule Mailer
projects.description: A final project worked on as part of DaVinci Coders. This website will keep track of topics that you wish to be reminded of each week. It will send out an email with a reminder.
